recipes.name: Bronze Ingot
recipes.description: Two copper ores smelted with coal. The first alloy.

recipes.name: Steel Ingot
recipes.description: Iron and coal in equal measure. Stronger than bronze.

recipes.name: Flame Blade
recipes.description: A blade that burns with divine fire. Hephaestus forged the first one for Ares.

recipes.name: Aegis Shield
recipes.description: A shield that turns away mortal blows. Athena carries one.

recipes.name: Winged Sandals
recipes.description: Sandals that carry the wearer between worlds. Hermes wears them still.

recipes.name: Thunderbolt Head
recipes.description: The head of a thunderbolt. Hephaestus forges these for Zeus alone.
